title: morus alba subvar. rosea
intro: Morus alba subvar. rosea, commonly known as White Mulberry, is a deciduous tree that is native to Asia and is known for its white flowers and edible fruit. The health benefits of White Mulberry include reducing inflammation, improving insulin sensitivity, and lowering cholesterol levels, making it a potential natural remedy for managing diabetes and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of White Mulberry include acting as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and hypoglycemic agent, which can help to reduce oxidative stress and improve glucose metabolism. The bioactive constituents of White Mulberry include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
